writeup.title: feat(reviews): add review flagging and admin moderation
writeup.summary: Introduces review moderation, allowing authenticated customers to flag reviews with predefined reasons. Accumulating three flags automatically hides a review from product listings and calculations, and administrators can review hidden reports at a new endpoint.
changes: Added a review_flags table and status column on reviews via database migration 0004.
Added POST /reviews/<id>/flag endpoint allowing users to flag reviews subject to validation rules.
Added GET /reviews/hidden endpoint for administrators to list and inspect hidden reviews.
Filtered out hidden reviews from product review lists and rating summaries.
Added validation rules ensuring authors cannot flag their own reviews and users cannot flag the same review twice.

functions.what_it_does: Flags a review by ID for the current authenticated user with a given reason.
Lists hidden reviews for administrators with pagination and flag counts.
Returns a query for published reviews for a product, ordered newest first.
Computes rating count and average rating for published reviews of a product.
Records a user flag on a review and hides the review if the flag count reaches the threshold.
Returns a query selecting hidden reviews ordered by ID.
Placeholder function for review moderation scoring that is not yet implemented.

writeup.release_note: Customers can flag reviews (POST /reviews/<id>/flag). Three flags hide a review; admins list hidden reviews at GET /reviews/hidden.
